items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 0.6% in 1985 to 0.9% in 2025 across 397 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

94 of 533 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 26 for salt or chloride; 5 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 533 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 1 of 1 high-need ones have none.
